snippets.snippet: /** * @brief Calculates the n-th Fibonacci number using memoization. * * @details This function recursively calculates the Fibonacci number for a given index n. * It uses memoization (caching) to store already computed values and avoid * redundant calculations, significantly improving performance for large n * compared to naive recursion. * Base cases: F(0) = 0, F(1) = 1. * * @param n The index of the Fibonacci number to calculate (non-negative integer). * @param memo A map (e.g., `std::map<int, long long>`) to store already computed * Fibonacci numbers. Key is the index n, value is F(n). Passed by reference * and modified by the function to cache results. * * @return The value of the n-th Fibonacci number (`long long`). * * @throw std::invalid_argument If n is negative. * @throw std::overflow_error If the result of adding F(n-1) + F(n-2) exceeds * the maximum value for `long long`. (Theoretical). * * @note Memoization makes this recursive implementation efficient, approaching * O(n) complexity. The `memo` map should be initialized (at least empty) * before the first call for a specific sequence of calculations. * * @warning For very large values of n (system-dependent), a stack overflow might * occur due to deep recursion, even with memoization (though at much larger n * than without it). The result might exceed the maximum value of `long long` * (typically for n > ~92). * * @par Algorithm (Pseudocode): * @code * 1. IF n < 0 THEN THROW invalid_argument. * 2. IF n == 0 OR n == 1 THEN RETURN n. * 3. CHECK IF n exists as a key in `memo`. * 4. IF value found in `memo` THEN RETURN it. * 5. IF value not found THEN: * a. SET F_n_minus_1 = calculateFibonacci(n - 1, memo). * b. SET F_n_minus_2 = calculateFibonacci(n - 2, memo). * c. SET result = F_n_minus_1 + F_n_minus_2. (Check for overflow!) * d. STORE result in `memo` with key n. * e. RETURN result. * @endcode * * @par Usage Example: * @code * #include <iostream> * #include <map> * // ... (calculateFibonacci function definition here) ... * std::map<int, long long> fib_cache; * try { std::cout << "Fib(10) = " << calculateFibonacci(10, fib_cache); } // Expected: 55 * catch (const std::exception& e) { std::cerr << "Error: " << e.what(); } * @endcode * * @par Test Example (Google Test): * @code{.cpp} * // Requires <gtest/gtest.h>, <map>, and calculateFibonacci definition * TEST(FibonacciMemoized, HandlesSmallValues) { * std::map<int, long long> cache; // New cache for each test * EXPECT_EQ(calculateFibonacci(0, cache), 0); * EXPECT_EQ(calculateFibonacci(1, cache), 1); * EXPECT_EQ(calculateFibonacci(10, cache), 55); * } * @endcode * * @par Benchmark Example (Google Benchmark): * @code{.cpp} * // Requires <benchmark/benchmark.h>, <map>, and calculateFibonacci definition * static void BM_FibonacciMemoized(benchmark::State& state) { * std::map<int, long long> cache; int n = state.range(0); * for (auto _ : state) { benchmark::DoNotOptimize(calculateFibonacci(n, cache)); } * } * BENCHMARK(BM_FibonacciMemoized)->Arg(20)->Arg(40); // Run with BENCHMARK_MAIN() * @endcode * * @par Mathematical Model (Binet's Formula): * The closed-form solution for Fibonacci numbers: * @f[ * F_n = \frac{\phi^n - \psi^n}{\sqrt{5}} * @f] * where @f$ \phi = \frac{1 + \sqrt{5}}{2} @f$ (the golden ratio) and @f$ \psi = \frac{1 - \sqrt{5}}{2} @f$. * * @par Statistics and Complexity: * - **Time Complexity:** O(n). Each subproblem F(k) is computed only once. * - **Space Complexity:** O(n) for storing the cache (`memo`) and O(n) for the recursion call stack. * - **Cyclomatic Complexity:** Low (around 4-6). * * @see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fibonacci_number (English) * @see https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/Числа_Фибоначчи (Russian) * @ref calculateFibonacciIterative "Iterative implementation (if available)" * * @author Igors Volohovs * @date 2024-08-01 * @version 1.3 (Translated to English, updated author/usage/pseudocode) * * @todo Check and add explicit handling for `long long` overflow. * @bug Potential `long long` overflow for n > ~92 is not explicitly handled. * */ // long long calculateFibonacci(int n, std::map<int, long long>& memo); // Example function signature $$ // Placeholder for cursor position after insertion
